summary: Mary Scott King, 50, of Huntington Beach CA, snowboarding with a Telluride Helitrax guide in the Mineral Creek drainage east of Ophir Pass, fell backward headfirst into a snow-covered creek at the bottom of the 'Out of Ophrica' run; her helmet wedged under an undercut rock and she drowned. Guides extricated her and performed CPR; medical help was flown in; she was pronounced dead at the scene ~noon.
location: Mineral Creek drainage, east of Ophir Pass ('Out of Ophrica' run)
notes: Inserted 2026-09-18 (run 888). Year pinned: Helitrax founded 1982 (city-data) + 'first fatality in 28 years of operation' -> 2010; guide 'Hilaree O'Neill' is her pre-2012 married name; 2010-01-16 was a Saturday (weekday-verified); corroborated by a wire-style article (Calameo scan) plus the Telluride-paper text quoted on The Ski Diva forum. San Miguel County Coroner Bob Dempsey handled the body and Sheriff Bill Masters was quoted — county=San Miguel. No SAR-team deployment documented; medical help flown in.
